# W3.CSS

`w3-4.15.css` is the unmodified W3.CSS 4.15 (December 2020) stylesheet,
downloaded on 2026-10-09 from https://www.w3schools.com/w3css/4/w3.css.
It is served from this site instead of the external w3schools URL.
Retain its embedded copyright and normalize.css license notices.
